## Feature Summary
A brief description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation
Why would this be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
If you have an idea of how it should work, describe it here.

## Detection Signal (if applicable)
If this is a new detection method, describe:
- What artifacts or signals it would analyze
- What image types would benefit
- Any relevant research papers

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Additional Context
Any mockups, references, or related issues.
